channel.title: The Margins
channel.description: Reporting on displacement, housing and water.

item.title: How the Midterms Could Change U.S. Refugee Policy
item.description: The election handed Democrats control of the next Congress and a chance to challenge President Trump's refugee policy from the committee chairs and the floor of both chambers. Their terms begin on January 3, 2027. The president's current admissions determination and entry suspension remain in place.

item.title: When Federal Funding Cuts Reach Refugees’ Everyday Lives
item.description: After CWS announced its Orange County office would close, I traced how the suspension of refugee admissions and federal funding changes contributed to the decision, and what the closure means for families relying on help with housing, benefit applications and everyday life in Southern California.

item.title: Sant Antoni: A Leisure Spot
item.description: Researchers monitored people's activities while they rested, shopped or walked in the streets of Barcelona. Very few were doing strenuous physical activity.

item.title: The $27,000 Problem: Musasa’s Broken Pump and the Cost of Waiting
item.description: In June, a Musasa resident described spending 210,000 Burundian francs a month on water after a pump failure. Emergency deliveries arrived in July. Residents were still asking for the pump to be repaired.

item.title: Missing Ownership Papers
item.description: Ukraine's housing compensation scheme in June 2026 depended on evidence of ownership, damage assessments and funds to pay approved claims.

item.title: Water by Hand: A Human-Powered UV Device and Questions for a Field Trial
item.description: A crank or pedal powers a UV lamp. The next questions concern water quality, everyday use and repairs: what would it take to try the device outside the laboratory?

item.title: After Wang Fuk Court
item.description: What it takes to settle again after Hong Kong’s deadliest fire in over 70 years. For this independent follow-up, I contacted the Hong Kong Red Cross about the recovery and examined published personal accounts alongside government records.

item.title: CWS After the LA Fires
item.description: CWS’s response to the January 2025 fires: evacuation supplies, translated information and a shared registration system at the Wildfire Resource Hub.

item.title: After the Fire, Before a Lease
item.description: For renters displaced by Los Angeles's January 2025 fires, finding somewhere to stay left another question: how long could they afford to remain?

item.title: Sand Cartels: Illegal Dredging in Southeast Asia and Coastal Displacement
item.description: How sand extraction and the trade supplying land reclamation affect riverbanks, coastlines and the people living there.

item.title: The Room on the Form
item.description: Hong Kong maintains documents regarding the sleeping space of foreign domestic workers. Issues like storage places, laundry, and cameras may impact this space.

item.title: Sunday Rooms in Central
item.description: Cartons provided Filipina domestic workers with a place to rest on Central’s walkways.
